{{Infobox/Generic
|image=File:Accessory Bag.png
}}
'''Accessories''' are a category of items that grant buffs while held in a player's inventory or {{Item|Accessory Bag}}. While in the {{Item|Accessory Bag}}, they grant {{MP}}, which is a stat that improves [[Powers]] and grants [[Tuning Points]].

== Overview ==
'''Accessories''', while in the {{Item|Accessory Bag}}, grant [[Stats|stat]] buffs and abilities to the player. Additionally, each unique Accessory in the {{Item|Accessory Bag}} grants {{MP}} depending on its rarity.

=== Accessory Power ===
{{Main|Accessory Power}}
{{:Accessory Power/Mechanics}}

=== Enrichments ===
{{Main|Enrichments}}
'''Enrichments''' are items that can be applied to Accessories that are {{Legendary}} or higher. They can be purchased from {{NPCSprite|Elizabeth}} for {{Bits|5,000}} per and grant small stat boosts. An {{Item|Accessory Enrichment Swapper}} can be used to swap the applied '''Enrichment''' on all enriched Accessories.

=== Accessory Lines & Priority ===
Some '''Accessories''' can be upgraded into higher tiers through a variety of methods. The order in which most '''Accessories''' upgrade are as follows:

: '''Talisman → {{Green|Ring}} → {{Blue|Artifact}} → {{DarkPurple|Relic}} → {{Gold|Heirloom}}'''{{Footnote|The only {{Green|2}} Heirlooms in the game are the {{Item|Freshly Baked Heirloom}} and {{Item|Crux Heirloom}}. Generally, most Relics are {{Legendary}} instead.}}

Note that some Accessories do not start at {{Common}} or as a Talisman (e.g. {{Item|Devour Ring}}); some Accessories will skip a tier (e.g. {{Item|Burststopper Talisman}} and {{Item|Burststopper Artifact}}); and some Accessories will not be the rarity that their suffix suggests (e.g. the {{Item|Dwarven Metal Talisman}} is {{Uncommon}}; the {{Item|Tarantula Ring}} is {{Legendary}}).

Certain Accessories will take priority over others:
* If two or more of the same Accessory are in the player's inventory or {{Item|Accessory Bag}}, their effects and {{MP}} will not stack.
* If several Accessories of the same upgrade tree are in the player's {{Item|Accessory Bag}}, only the Accessory of the highest tier will take effect and grant {{MP}}. For example, if the player has a {{Item|Freshly Baked Relic}} and {{Item|Freshly Baked Heirloom}}, '''only''' the latter will take effect.

* {{Item|Talisman of Power}}

* {{Item|Artifact of Power}}

== Trivia ==
*{{Max MP}}
*Despite being referred to as '''Accessories''' since the release of the game, many players refer to them as '''Talismans''' due to the {{Item|Accessory Bag}} previously being called the Talisman Bag.
*Prior to October 5th, 2021, many '''Accessories''' in the same upgrade tree would be bugged to have their effects stack. This has since been patched.
*Currently, {{Green|6}} Accessory lines cannot have its rarity upgraded using a {{Item|Recombobulator 3000}}: {{Item|Beastslayer's Codex}}, {{Item|Book of Progression}}, {{Item|Pandora's Box}}, {{Item|Rift Prism}}, {{Item|Runebook}}, {{Item|Safety Badge}}, and {{Item|Supreme Voter's Badge}} line.<!--*If an accessory has player head texture, it can be worn on player's head, which will make it give stats, but not Accessory Power. The '''Armadillo Pet''' is a {{Skill|mining}} [[Pets|Mount]] [[Pets|Pet]] that is obtained via hatching [[Prehistoric Egg]]s. It can be ridden to break blocks in the {{Zone|Crystal Hollows}}.

== Obtaining ==
The '''Armadillo Pet''' hatches from a {{Item|Prehistoric Egg}} after walking a certain amount of steps to hatch it.
To obtain the {{Mythic}} '''Armadillo Pet''', one can use a {{Item|Frozen Scute}} and {{c|700,000}} to upgrade it at {{NPCSprite|Kat}}.

== Stats ==
{{PetStats}}

== Usage ==
The '''Armadillo Pet''' takes the form of a head on the ground when summoned. It will attempt to follow the player around, but it moves extremely slowly. If the pet is too far away, it may teleport to its owner.

Right-clicking the pet allows the player to mount it, allowing them to control its movements. The pet has an energy meter which appears above the XP bar when riding it; this meter's capacity is decided on by the pet's rarity.
*{{Common}}: 100
*{{Uncommon}}: 150
*{{Rare}}: 200
*{{Epic}}: 250
*{{Legendary}}: 300
*{{Mythic}}: 400
The pet's energy depletes when the Armadillo breaks a block.

When the pet's energy reaches 0, the Armadillo will stop moving, and stamina regen will halt. The stamina of the Armadillo naturally regenerates {{Green|0.33%}} of its maximum energy per second. The pet stops regenerating energy only while moving. It regenerates fully while riding so long as the player is stationary, as well as when they are not riding the pet.

== Trivia ==
*The {{Item|Armadillo Pet}} was the first to have five perks at {{Legendary}} rarity. It now shares this property with the {{Item|Kuudra Pet}}, {{Item|Subzero Wisp Pet}} and {{Item|Jade Dragon Pet}}.
*While holding a {{Item|Pickonimbus 2000}} or Drill, breaking blocks with the Armadillo Pet will use up durability/fuel. If the Pickonimbus breaks or the drill runs out of fuel, blocks will still be broken, but the tool's stats will not apply.
*The Armadillo used to not give any gemstones when using it to mine gemstones without a proper pickaxe, but breaking gemstones could still display "Rolling Miner granted you double drops" in chat.
*This pet can ride minecarts.
*It used to be possible to obtain a {{Mythic}} Armadillo Pet via a glitch. This did not provide any additional perks, just pet score and SkyBlock XP.
